posts.author: BluesandClues
posts.paraphrase: Opening post. Asks for laptop shoulder bag suggestions that are like the basic black ones sold everywhere but more stylish.
posts.quote: basic black ones you can get, but nicer?

posts.author: SaintHonoria
posts.paraphrase: Recommends Matt & Nat, saying the brand has many styles that can fit a laptop.
posts.quote: Matt & Nat have lots of styles that would accommodate a laptop.

posts.author: PlumPeony
posts.paraphrase: Suggests looking on Vinted or eBay for secondhand options.
posts.quote: Have you looked at vinted (or ebay) ?

posts.author: Softpebbles
posts.paraphrase: Recommends a black i-stay laptop bag (15.6-16 inch) with a non-slip shoulder strap; says they own one and rate it highly.
posts.quote: I have one of these and it’s excellent.

posts.author: startingoveragainagain
posts.paraphrase: Recently bought a taupe Smythson slim briefcase in Panama leather and is happy with it.
posts.quote: I recently got this and it's lovely

posts.author: BluesandClues
posts.paraphrase: Thanks the previous poster and says Smythson's vegan satchel is very beautiful.
posts.quote: Oh their vegan satchel is beyond beautiful! Thank you!

posts.author: deedeemegadoodoo
posts.paraphrase: Not fussed about leather, so bought a briefcase-style bag from Stackers, which comes in several colours. A colleague bought the backpack version instead.
posts.quote: I got a lovely briefcase style one from Stackers.

posts.author: BluesandClues
posts.paraphrase: Finds the Stackers bag very pretty and is considering buying it.
posts.quote: Oh that’s so pretty! I might get that one.

posts.author: CalicoPusscat
posts.paraphrase: Finds laptop bags generally too large. Measured their own laptop (9 x 14 inches) and plans to shop around for a smaller bag.
posts.quote: Laptop bags seem to be so huge?
